2girls, side-by-side, sitting, eating, indoors, night, window, snowfall, table, food, steam, warm lighting, scenery. Landscape game promotional illustration, medium-wide three-quarter view. Wu sits on the left and Xingyue on the right, sharing a quiet meal at a small table.

A modern room in a futuristic city, matte composite walls and a large window. An amber pendant lamp above the table lights both faces, hands and steaming bowls. Wu holds a steamed bun near her mouth; Xingyue raises a spoonful of soup. The closed window frames a nearly black city, faint building silhouettes and sparse snowflakes caught by indoor light. The exterior remains much darker than the room. Group the lamp, faces and food as one warm focal area against cool charcoal shadows. Both faces and eating gestures are clearly visible; the tabletop separates their hands.

very aesthetic, masterpiece, no text, painterly, anime illustration, opaque brush strokes, broad color masses, hard-edged shadows.

Complete readable silhouettes; coherent volumes built with broad directional paint planes. Group hair into substantial locks and cloth into a few structural folds, with quiet interior areas. Use muted colored grays with concentrated richer accents and a clear light-shadow grouping. Refine anime eyes, faces, hands and story props selectively; simplify the surroundings. Keep economical colored structural lines and varied handmade edges.
